intro: The Restless Dead addresses an alarming disturbance within the crypts of the Hall of Thanes, where ancient dwarven spirits have been roused from their rest. With the caretakers terrified to enter the vaults, an adventurer must descend into the catacombs to put the angry phantoms and the spirit of Anvilmar back to sleep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.
Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah good, it's done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
